messages:
sam-oncall: Noticed a small but persistent spike in TLS handshake failures for eu-west->us-east routes after the morning deploy. Opening a thread for remediation tracking.

mira-sre: thanks, can you attach a few representative logs or traces?

sam-oncall: put a sample in the incident doc. snippet: ```ERROR tls: handshake timeout; peer=10.2.4.17; route=eu-west->us-east; retries=4```

leo-neteng: checking LB egress metrics now. I see clustered SYN retransmits and reduced MSS on SYN-ACKs between 09:10-09:25. Possibly PMTU or a middlebox dropping fragments.

dan-platform: FYI the canary used sticky session routing and bumped inflight to 50 which may have kept traffic on a path with the bad gateway.

mira-sre: action item: leo to gather pcap + run traceroute/tcpdump to the gateway and post links. Due: EOD Thu.

leo-neteng: ack. starting packet captures; will upload to s3 and note timestamps.

ashley-pm: who owns the rollout gate for TLS error thresholds? want auto-rollback if >0.5% for 10m.

dan-platform: platform team handles that. I'll add an alert + automated runbook trigger. ETA 48h.

ops-bot: INC-4981 created: "TLS handshakes up on cross-region egress" assigned to leo-neteng, mira-sre.

mira-sre: also adding per-route handshake-failure metric to Console dashboard. Owner: mira-sre, PR by next Tue.

leo-neteng: early root cause: one egress gateway was advertising a smaller MSS in SYN-ACKs causing endpoints to send larger segments that get dropped. Quick mitigation: enable tcp_mtu_probing on the gateway.

sam-oncall: please document exact command and staged rollout steps.

leo-neteng: sysctl command: `sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_mtu_probing=1`. Rollout: eu-west-staging -> eu-west-canary -> eu-west-prod with 5m observation windows.

mira-sre: risk note: kernel TCP change; do 30m canary with alerts and manual rollback plan.

ashley-pm: timeline: can we test staging tomorrow AM and aim for prod by Fri EOD if green?

dan-platform: I'll wire the alert hooks and make the rollback playbook live today; if leo confirms staging, Fri prod target looks feasible.

leo-neteng: staging test started; MSS issue reproduced, enabling mtu probing bumped handshake success from 99.2% -> 99.98% on synthetic load. Uploaded pcap: s3://redwood-logs/pcaps/1871234567-mtu-issue.pcap

mira-sre: great. dan-platform, add a runbook hook to post to this thread when the alert fires: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/egress-tls-failures

dan-platform: done. added playbook template + automated slack message for rollback.

ashley-pm: I'll schedule a Fri status check and draft a customer update if needed. :thumbsup:

sam-oncall: Summary of action items: 1) leo  staging verification + pcap (EOD Thu). 2) dan-platform  alert + rollback automation (48h). 3) mira-sre  per-route metric PR (next Tue) + weekly follow-ups for 4 weeks. 4) ashley-pm communicate schedule to oncall rotation. Will close thread after 24h stable in prod.

ops-bot: Note: RDW-405 linked for dashboard work.

leo-neteng: prod rollout completed, monitoring. will post any regressions here.

mira-sre: after 6h prod stable, requesting automated report for handshake by route. owner: mira-sre.

sam-oncall: keeping thread open for 24h post-stable. closing notes will be added to incident doc.
